notes.title: Season 6 Update v1.6.0【7/31 Update】
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you for playing Faaast Penguin.
Here are the contents changed during maintenance that occurred on 7/31/2025.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]New World \[Miami Splash] Unveiled![/b][/h2][p]The 10th world, \[Miami Splash] has been added!
This time, the stage is set in the blazing sun and blue seas of midsummer Miami.
Race through 4 new courses where you can weave through roads lined with colorful cars and race across seas bustling with boats![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/26589df4836a504acdc71bd5f055d3d4a291fc8f.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]A new gimmick that uses water, Jetpack, added![/b][/h2][p]When you pick up a Plastic Bottle, the Jetpack on your back fills up with water!
Hold the jump button mid-air to shoot water from your Jetpack and go higher!
Try taking routes in high places or gliding over the open sea where there’s no road![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/e29bcda5cb95309187f3775167215b7a192b5a1d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/e7ccfa28f080823f96060b9b8798d35f132e8cb9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Also, there’s a slight chance you’ll pick up Bubbly Water when you pick up a Plastic Bottle!
The bubbles will burst, launching you straight ahead in a flash![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/d9b4b76abd6e911f157e3610ba272c86e6964853.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Season 6 Details: [/p][p][url="https://faaast-penguin.com/en/news/6585/"]https://faaast-penguin.com/en/news/6585/[/url][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Added “Winners” in Results![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/d32c620927854d5762ebad6d9747393062ace66b.png"][/img]
On the results screen, in addition to medals earned, top players will now be recognized as “winners.”
When you win, you will earn 4 season rank points (2 Blue Badges).[/p][h3][b]Winning Criteria[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Less than 20 participants: The top 6 players will be recognized as winners.[/p][/*][*][p]More than 20 participants: The top 8 players will be recognized as winners.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Season Rank Thresholds Adjustment[/b][/h2][p]The thresholds for season ranks have also been adjusted as follows:[/p][list][*][p]Ordinary: 4　→　4[/p][/*][*][p]Best in the Village: 20　→　20[/p][/*][*][p]Pro: 60　→　60[/p][/*][*][p]Top-Notch: 150　→　150[/p][/*][*][p]Ace: 400　→　350[/p][/*][*][p]Star: 800　→　700[/p][/*][*][p]Master: 1500　→　1400[/p][/*][*][p]Legend: 2500　→　2500[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]A first-time bonus has been added when purchasing 500 Crystals![/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/706386a368021a4e121c7c89c62606aec43e8818.png"][/img][/p][p]When you purchase 500 Crystals for the first time, you’ll now receive an additional 500 Crystals as a bonus, giving you 1,000 total.[/p][p]This bonus also applies to players who purchased 500 Crystals before Season 5, as long as it’s their first purchase in Season 6 or later.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]\[Select Server] has been moved to \[Select Play Mode] / settings screen[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/ea4c01459785f2e0eb9c3e008fa783c367131c3a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/ba701699d069ba6a78b6cc47c98dee441ba3e004.png"][/img]
We’ve moved the server selection feature from the home screen to the \[Select Play Mode] and settings screen.[/p][p]Previously, settings were changed unintentionally or adjusted early on in a way that increased matching time. We’ve made this change since the accuracy of the \[Automatic (recommended)] setting has improved since our launch.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]A feature to copy tour results has been added to private matches!  (PC version only)[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/70a3a3dd9e5103492617da86248103ac85ce06ca.png"][/img]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/32e25b1d58a7c4591e85a89daf98d97cc5504dba.png"][/img][/p][p]You can now copy the results of the last tour you raced in text format to your clipboard from the results screen or the room screen.[/p][p]The text includes the final rankings, player names, and scores, as well as the results of each activity. notes.title: Season 5 Update v1.5.0
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Faaast Penguin.
Here are the contents changed during maintenance that occurred on 5/29/2025.

[h2]New World [Star Drop] Unveiled![/h2]
The 9th world, [Star Drop] has been added!
The world is set in a kingdom high above the ground, where shooting stars fall.
Race through four new courses, encounter herds of glowing jellyfish, and explore a place where you can hop around floating islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/fd2c6ae1a227483088e57acf79af5490681c8d31.png[/img]

[h2]A new gimmick that lets you soar through the night sky using stars![/h2]
Collect stars from the meteor showers and Star Mice, then dash through the night sky by attacking the stars above!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/767f2a9bf0383a7df8b6aa2e6910667034796c7a.png[/img]

When you pick up a [Star] that falls on the course or attack a [Star Mouse], you’ll get a [Star]!
Use a [Star] to attack a [Star Frames]!
Right after a rival penguin attacks a [Star Frames], you can attack without consuming a [Star].
Ride the stars and surge ahead!

Season 5 Details: https://faaast-penguin.com/en/news/5290/

[h2It is now easier for attacks to land. It’s especially improved on the Switch![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/45d41bf24cc21649bc080f6dff6ff1e0f782b29f.png[/img]

The time between the start of attacks and the activation of hitboxes has been shortened, making it easier for attacks to land.

The reasons for the change are as follows:

・Many players, during their first playthrough, would press the attack button just as they overlap with a seal and repeatedly fail to land the attack.
・On platforms like Switch, where the frame rate may fall below 60fps, a phenomenon occurred where attacks were less likely to hit because the character’s position would change between the button press and hitbox activation.

Attacking is the most fundamental action in this game, and players should be able to experience success with it right from the start. At the same time, we aim to minimize differences between platforms as much as possible.

Previously, there was a delay between pressing the button and the hitbox activating, in sync with the character’s animation. With this update, the hitbox now activates immediately when the button is pressed.

We will continue to monitor how this change affects game balance and make further adjustments if necessary. Additionally, this update only speeds up the hitbox activation timing. No other elements have been changed.

[h2]You can now expand the emote slots! 20% off until June 11th![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/cbaa2350f0731def2554f3067c0d278e983795af.png[/img]

The moment we’ve all been waiting for!
You can now expand the emote slots from the default 4 to 16 slots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/448b4c920d29a32aff8a745ba37cc77f8c0f9fdf.png[/img]

Buying one expansion slot at the shop will increase your capacity by 4. To celebrate the launch, enjoy 20% off until June 11th. Be sure to take advantage of this offer!

[h2]We’ve added a tutorial mode![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/d26259207f1280ff62ef0e7c0127a068d27f51a6.png[/img]

A playable tutorial has been added immediately after starting the game!
You can learn how to execute attacks, consecutive attacks, jumps, and Ultimates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/1054061d885f0e381495d89564874910e12d4349.png[/img]

The tutorial is available both immediately after starting the game and from the home screen menu.

[h2]We’ve added a feature in private match spectator mode that lets you jump to a specific rank! (PC version only)[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/0f56aca12822f34a5c9547d9e09fb91ab78d696d.png[/img]

In private match spectator mode (PC version only), pressing keys 1 to 5 on the keyboard allows you to jump between the spectator view of players ranked 1st through 5th.

Since this feature is designed as a hidden function only for the PC version—aimed at tournament commentary and interactive streams—there is no UI display for it.

[h2]Sands of Egypt Night Paaarty world will undergo renewal.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/d3b0be891252b6d8395f655d2c543080697496e6.png[/img]

The existing Sands of Egypt Night Paaarty world will undergo renewal.
Note: Worlds that undergo renewal will eventually become available again.


[h2]Newly Added[/h2]
[h3]All Platforms[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 4 courses to the new world [Star Drop]
[*] Added new gimmicks [Star], [Star Mouse], and [Star Frames]
[*] Added [Emote Slot Expansion] function.
[list]
[*] Emote slot expansions can be purchased at the shop.
[/list]
[*] Added a playable tutorial.
[*] Added function that allows you to switch through specific ranks in private match spectator mode (PC version only).
[*] Added feature to the challenge screen that categorizes event challenges into individual tabs for easier browsing.
[*] Added an emote volume adjustment option to the settings screen.
[*] Products added to the shop
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]All Platforms[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted attack hitboxes.
[*] Adjusted to prevent the number of players who can finish from changing when other players leave during an activity.
[*] Adjusted podium display to show the name, nameplate, and points of players who left before the tour ended.
[*] Adjusted the appearance positions for some paraglider balls.
[*] Adjusted the positions for some paragliders to make it less likely for players to fall off the course when the effect ends.
[*] Adjusted the hitbox for attacking balloons.
[*] Adjusted so that the players are no longer knocked back when colliding with balloons without attacking.
[*] Adjusted so that the seal punching bags return to their initial position when they fall off the course.
[*] Adjusted the retreat timing for some seals.
[*] Adjusted the item code input limit to eight characters.
[*] Adjusted so that spinning seals do not stop when attacked.
[*] Optimizations to improve game performance.
[*] Fixed bugs and made minor adjustments to some courses.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]All Platforms[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the effect of the [Secret Scroll of Ninja Techniques] obtained on the floating islands would sometimes be visible to other players during the first activity.
[*] Fixed a bug where wearing certain costumes while using the [Baby Gray] body color could cause visible glitches.
[*] Adjusted other minor issues.
[/list]

Known Issues
https://faaast-penguin.com/en/news/948/


We thank you for your continued support of Faaast Penguin.

[list]

[h3]You can now set the drop out option on or off![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/baabb9c3d1def4270638f283c4567c936fc13e39.png[/img]
Private match hosts can now change the rules.
New drop out [off] setting available.

With the drop out setting turned [off], all participants get to compete for points until the end.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/9dae553aabd5485769721cf13cd5d3cd5c43d02d.png[/img]

Those able to finish each activity get points, and all participants will be able to race to the end of the tours.

[b]Around 10 players can enjoy racing all the way to the end.[/b]
Under the normal rules, it was difficult to attack with fewer people in the second half of an activity due to drop outs in private matches of around 10 players. This setting is recommended as it allows players to get to the end with the same number of players the race started with.

• For matches with 30 or more players
Since courses are designed to reduce the number of participants for the final activity, the drop out [on] setting is recommended.

[h3]Adjustments made so that room IDs don’t change![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/7f543e436d27d546c6d196705303971cad0a2775.png[/img]
Private room IDs are now fixed from the time of creation until closing.
Until now, room IDs changed after each tour, so hosts needed to share the room ID with participants every time. This change reduces the hassle of having to share room IDs each time and makes it easier to join in the middle of play.

[h2]The [Palau Brunch] world is under renewal.[/h2]

• Explanation of the world number adjustments
When the game first released, it only had 4 worlds and 16 courses, which made it feel a bit short. But with the inclusion of the newly added Italian Crunch, it went up to 7 worlds and 28 courses in total.

Since Faaast Penguin is a racing game, the more you learn about the courses, the better you’ll be able to race. We have decided that this wasn’t good for new players or those who want to master the courses, as it raised the hurdle for improvement with so many courses continually being added.

That’s why there will be 6 worlds and 24 courses in Season 3. Worlds that undergo renewal will eventually become available again with improvements. We hope you enjoy the 6 worlds mentioned above in Season 3!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/280725236f489c1bf381f32b71433f5b70c052b2.png[/img]
Earn costumes, ultimates, rides, and emotes to fire you up for the party according to the level of your tier.

[h2]The Frame Rate Has Improved for The Nintendo Switch![/h2]
We have optimized processing during activities on the Nintendo Switch and improved the frame rate. With this optimization, the performance for other platforms have slightly improved as well.

[h2]New Season Rank System Implemented[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/d43ae46de3b5a028f5934adbf36960b5986b5de3.png[/img]
Based on the results of Season 1, we have adjusted the number of Season Rank Points earned and thresholds for each rank.
[h3]Season Rank Points Earned[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tour 1st Place (Gold Medal): 8pts → 16pts
[*] Tour 2nd Place (Silver Medal): 6pts → 12pts
[*] Tour 3rd Place (Bronze Medal): 4pts → 8pts
[*] Tour Completed – 4th Place and lower (Blue Badge): 1pt → 2pts
[*] Top Three in Activity: 1pt → 2pts (2 Red Badges)
[*] Activity Completed – 4th Place and lower: 0pt → 1pt (1 Red Badge)
[/list]
[h3]Season Rank Thresholds[/h3]
With the changes to the points earned, it is now approximately 2 to 4 times easier to earn points compared to Season 1. Accordingly, the thresholds for Season Ranks have also been adjusted as follows:
[list]
[*] Ordinary: 2 → 4
[*] Best in the Village: 10 → 20
[*] Pro: 30 → 60
[*] Top-Notch: 100 → 150
[*] Ace: 300 → 400
[*] Star: 800 → 800
[*] Master: 1400 → 1500
[*] Legend: 2000 → 2500
[/list]
[h3]Reasons for the Change[/h3]
Season Ranks and Season Rank Points are aimed at creating a system outlined below:
[list]
[*] Providing a meaningful goal for those who play consistently on a daily basis.
[*] Allowing players to set their own goals and enjoy the game at their own pace.
[*] Players aiming to improve have the opportunity to compete and enjoy testing their skills.
[/list]
Given these goals and the luck-based game mechanics, this game incorporates an incremental point system. This system is designed to reflect a player’s skill while still allowing for casual and enjoyable gameplay.

However, with the points allocation system used in Season 1, if the players didn’t place in the top 3 of the tour, they could only earn a small amount of points. Additionally, the system was heavily influenced by the matching process, which made it difficult to achieve a balance for everyone’s goals.

Our changes this time make it so that while skill is still reflected, players can also accumulate points by completing various activities and reaching set goals within them.

[h2]Newly Added[/h2]
[h3]All Platforms[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added 4 courses to the new world [Tropical Hawaii Night Paaarty]
[*] Added new gimmicks [Dancing Bear] and [Sardine Can Ball]!
[*] New Season Pass [Crazy Night Paaarty!] added
[*] Products for the new season added to the shop
[*] Implemented a new Season Rank Point System
[*] New category [Standard] added to the shop
[*] You can now view your past season rank results.
[/list]

[h2]Adjustments[/h2]
[h3]All Platforms[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased the content of the seal punching bags and made adjustments to prevent excessive fluctuations.
[*] The Season Rank leaderboard will display rankings up to 100th place.
[*] Adjusted the effects displayed when completing an activity.
[*] Improved processing load during activities.
[*] Shortened respawn time for sardine cans.
[*] While driving, adjustments have been made so that input in diagonal directions also makes it easier to turn sideways (since there is no speed change with forward input during driving, inputs for left and right only are sufficient).
[*] Fixed bugs and made minor adjustments to some courses.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[h3]All Platforms[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where challenges requiring specific costumes or rides to be equipped would count progress based on the appearance gear when using the appearance function.
[*] Fixed a bug in private matches where ghosts were visible to remaining players.

notes.title: Update v1.0.5: Added server settings and ghost mode for solo
notes.notes:
Thank you for enjoying Faaast Penguin.

Here are the details of the changes implemented in the maintenance conducted on October 17, 2024.

[h2]Auto (Prioritize Connection Speed)" has been added to the server selection[/h2]

The "Auto (Prioritize Connection Speed)" option has been added to the server settings. This option prioritizes matching based on connection speed by excluding slower servers, while considering the matchmaking rate and wait times. We recommend using this option for general play, but for more detailed control, you can select from other server options.

This brings the server settings to a total of six options: "Auto (Prioritize Connection Speed)", "Auto (Prioritize Matchmaking)", "Asia", "West America", "East America", and "Europe".
Additionally, the server selection screen has been moved to the home screen.

[h2]Ghost Mode is now available after elimination in single-player mode[/h2]

Ghost Mode can now be used even after elimination during single-player tours.
Additionally, in Ghost Mode, players can collect items like Mackerel Cans and Paraglider Balls, allowing them to practice in a way that closely resembles actual gameplay.

[h2]Matchmaking has been adjusted[/h2]

Matchmaking logic has been adjusted to make it easier to match players with similar ratings.
Further adjustments will be continuously implemented.

[h3]For further details, please refer to the information below.

https://faaast-penguin.com/en/news/2055/[/h3]

We appreciate your continued support of Faaast Penguin.

notes.title: Matching Speed Improved! North American Servers Expanded [Update Information]
notes.notes:
Thank you for your patience! The update is now complete!
We apologize for any inconvenience caused during maintenance.

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Matchmaking speed has improved![/h3]
We have optimized the matchmaking logic. Additionally, you can now view the status of matchmaking.

[h3]We have added North American servers![/h3]
We expanded from one North American server to two regions.

[h3]New name display settings for streamers' nameplates have been added![/h3]
In the options menu, you can toggle the display of your name in-game and on the nameplate. Streamers, please use this feature according to your needs!
＊Currently, this function is only implemented on PCs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160313/33dad2173b3556562c5728405ecfd74f595e34af.png[/img]
Names can be completely hidden by turning off “Display other players' names” and setting “Display overhead player name” to not show.

[h2]Request to Select Server Region(For Addressing Lag Issues)[/h2]
Currently, there is an issue where you may connect to a server that is not optimal for matchmaking. By selecting a server region close to your location, you can enjoy a smoother gaming experience.

From the "Select Play Mode" on the home screen, you can choose from the following regions:
